main_measure.name: clustered-by-day t of the slope of drift-adjusted next 5-bar return on forecast, trending grid bars
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2 and supporting mean > 0; reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2; else inconclusive

supporting_check.name: mean short-side unusual move on grid cases with forecast < 0

decided_by: Confirm rule: the slope is positive with t >= 2 and the supporting short-side mean is above 0.
reading: Grid = rows 0,5,10,... of each window; normal drift = the coin's mean non-overlapping 5-bar return over all its windows; in-regime = regime 'trending'; slope t uses day-clustered (CR1) standard errors; the situation check takes profile = regime 'trending', 20-day fall from prices (regime where not computable) and shrinkage = raw dryup < 0; fewer than the plan's minimum cases is reported as 'not observable'.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.0006133 on the check folds against +0.001952 on every fold
